essence: The child-initiation rite: expanded from Tantrāloka, stated condensed here.
The rite is expanded, determined from the Tantrāloka — authority by derivation.
Condensed, it is stated here — the manual's own restatement.
Third-day samaya-close; group-sacrifice in trident-lotus mandala; Aiśa-to-āgneya row of deities installed.
The three Parās placed on the trident axes — each in its own place.
All-place-enshrinement of the Goddess makes all complete.
The middle-axis deity-wheel worshipped by non-difference-alone; its enshrinement makes worship everywhere.
Five grounds — pot, kalasa, mandala, fire, self — joined by non-difference; special-worship with the Lord two-nature-juice's flowers.
The sacrifice-place: satisfaction-food complete, without wealth-deception.
Wealth absent: no great-mandala-sacrifice — indeed.
Living animals offered.
By compassion in the animal-rite: no doubt — they too become graced.
Sesame-ghee, vapa-hom, fat-satisfied deity-wheel, disciple placed before the all-path-complete self.
Parokṣa-dīkṣā: the living-dead one contemplated — or his darba-cow-dung likeness established in front.
Disciple sprinkled, flowered, whole path placed in his body.
For the enjoyer, the auspicious is not cleansed.
For the seeker, auspicious-and-unauspicious — both even.
The seedless: covenant-nooses cleansed even for most-foolish — the Lord's command; attainment by teacher-deity-fire devotion-faith alone.
Everywhere habit-capture distinguishes: mantras work by habit-conformity.
Traced habit-distinction, main-mantra-consideration, Siva-two-nature-contemplation cleanses the in-body path.
The disciple's consciousness made non-different from self — rest in infinite-bliss-lake, freedom-sovereignty essence; non-different from the Lord he becomes.
Enjoyment-seeker joined where his desire stands.
Residual-function body suddenly pure-tattva — the all-noose-releasing initiation.
Disciple worships guru by fees.
Fire-rite with Sri-Para-mantra, three oblations per tattva, complete with vausad.
Siva-end-tattva-purification, then the yojanika-order full-offering.
Two offerings: enjoyment-place for yojanā; pure-tattva-creation for the other.
Guru-worship by fees — the child-initiation names itself.
The ongoing tattva, past-and-future excluded: act purified.

rasa.dominant: śānta with vidhi weight (quiescence carrying rite-order)
rasa.justification: The relish is order itself: install, place, join, cleanse, offer, name — each imperative lands and the next begins; śānta is the rite's calm, the identity-climax (u21) its single exultant chord.

sections.FUNCTION: States the putrakadīkṣā: mandala-installation, Parā-placement, five-ground joining, paśu and wealth rules, disciple preparation and identity-attainment, seedless and habit-mantra doctrine, fire-rites, and the self-naming close.
sections.KEY TERMS: putrakadīkṣā (child-initiation); trirāsa-placement (the three Parās on axes); pañcādhikaraṇa (five-ground join); paśu-vidhi (animal-rite with compassion); nirbījā (seedless initiation); vāsanā-grahaṇa (habit-capture as bhedaka); abhinnī-kṛta-caitanya (disciple-self identity); pūrṇā-huti + vauṣaḍ (the closing offerings).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 14 condenses the Tantrāloka putraka-dīkṣā material; the identity-climax (u21) echoes a12's samāveśa logic; feeds nothing later — a self-contained rite-manual.
sections.BOUNDARY: Animal-offering and wealth-rules stated as rite, no ethical commentary; nirbījā's grace for mūḍha attributed to parameśvara-ājñā, not argued; habit-mantra doctrine asserted in one verse (u19-20) without expansion.
sections.EXPLANATION: The rite proceeds: authority (Tantrāloka → condensed), installation (third-day mandala + Parā-axes + five-ground join), eligibility rules (wealth required, animals offered with compassion), preparation (disciple sprinkled, path placed in his body), climax (identity-attainment foot-thumb-to-twelve-end, rest in the bliss-lake), then the seedless/habit-mantra doctrine, fire-rites, offerings, and the self-naming close. Each step is imperative-ordered — the manual's form is its argument.
sections.RELATED: Tantrāloka putraka-dīkṣā source chapter (lore); a12 samāveśa parallels (identity clause); qa NEEDS_WITNESS expected.
